_doc: Pinned population baseline for the holdout net-positive rate. Committed to prereg/ so it is tracked and survives a fresh clone, unlike outputs/hyp01_results.json which is gitignored.
description: Fraction of ALL rankable families (not just survivors) that were net-positive in the holdout. This is the correct baseline for interpreting the survivor holdout net-positive rate (38.3%). A randomly-chosen family has 26.6% P(positive) out of sample, not 50%.
usage: src/report.py reads this file via _pop_net_positive_pct() to fix the banner that previously printed 'chance is 50%'.
